name: gui_build_full
description: GB-2, the build part: one project from File > New Project > Blank, with Studio's GUI only, holding everything GB-1 built in five (gui_build_A..E). Stage 1: the Graph tab's palette adds a render.material_pass of deferred_geometry_v1 (its draw loop comes along), Add Object > Cube and > Floor, the KeyLight at intensity 6 in the Inspector, Add fullscreen pass with Uses scene lights. Stage 2: Features > shadow_directional (RS-10), then the lighting pass's New... > Deferred lighting > Create (UX-5b: the G-buffer lines and shadow_map in one edit); its colour onto present's + input shows the lit box (not the gradient) and the box's shadow on the floor. Stage 3: the palette's render.compute row offers engine://rt_shadow_mask_pipeline (UX-5d), whose world_position and normal read the material pass by name. UX-6a decision 6: the lighting template declares an optional shadow_mask after its inputs, so the lighting node already offers binding 6; the mask dropped there puts the floor beside the box in the mask's hard shadow (the key light takes the darker of the shadow map and the mask). Nothing is typed in the shader. Stage 4: UX-6a decision 3: Add fullscreen pass makes its image R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT, so the lit image and the composite's are float with nothing picked; a bright pass (engine://bloom_highpass from the Fragment list), Add loop with a body pass, Count 4, the carry, the body image's size by f > Half each element, a composite (engine://bloom_composite) reading the lit colour and the loop's output; present takes the composite and the dark just above the floor's edges is lit by the bloom, while the top edge stays dark (UX-7 decision 1: the numbered inputs a fullscreen pass is given are clamped at the image's edge, so the floor no longer wraps round onto the top). Stage 5: a tone map pass, New... > Tone map > Create (UX-6a decision 1: the name field says tone_map, not the first New...'s deferred_lighting); present takes it and the floor the light made white has a tone again. The plan is checked: trace before lighting, lighting reading the shadow map and the mask, four copies with the carry, composite, tone map, present. UX-6a decision 2: with the Graph tab in front, the author edits shaders/tone_map.frag in their own editor -- a higher EXPOSURE changes the picture, and a second declared input appears on the tone map node as binding 1, without the Frame Plan tab and without Refresh. UX-6a decision 7: no settling wait before a gesture on the canvas's fields. Typed: the project folder and the name gb_full, material_pass and render.compute in the palette's filter, 6 in the light's intensity, 4 in Count, and the tone map shader's three edits (decision 2's check, not a stop).
